automatic_tax_status.description:
The automatic tax status of this checkout. One of:
- `APPLIED`: The automatic tax is applied.
- `DISABLED`: The automatic tax is disabled.
- `LOCATION_NOT_SUPPORTED`: Automatic tax calculation isn't supported in the customer's location.
- `LOCATION_NOT_REGISTERED_BY_MERCHANT`: The merchant isn't registered to collect tax in the customer's location.
- `ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE`: The customer address was insufficient or invalid to determine the correct tax.

created_at.description: Time when the Checkout Session was created.

discounts.description: List of discounts applied to the subscription or invoice. Discounts of line items are applied before subscription or invoice discounts. Currently, only one element is supported.

enable_automatic_tax.description: Whether automatic tax is enabled for this checkout. When enabled, the system attempts to calculate taxes for this checkout's invoice automatically.

expires_at.description: Time when the Checkout Session expires.

id.description: ID of the Checkout Session object.

mode.description:
The mode of the Checkout Session object, can be one of:
- `PAYMENT`: Accept one-off payments.
- `SUBSCRIPTION`: Set up subscriptions.
- `SETUP`: Collect payment details to charge your customers later.

status.description:
The status of the Checkout Session object, can be one of:
- `ACTIVE`: The Checkout Session is available for the customer to complete a purchase.
- `COMPLETED`: The Checkout Session has been completed.
- `CANCELLED`: The Checkout Session has been cancelled.
- `EXPIRED`: The Checkout Session has expired.

The status automatically changes from `ACTIVE` to `EXPIRED` after 1 hour if purchase has not been completed.

success_url.description: The URL the customer will be directed to after the checkout completion.

updated_at.description: Time when the Checkout Session was last updated.

account_id.description: ID of the Airwallex payment account used to collect payment. You can find this ID in the Airwallex web app > Settings > Account details, within the Account Information section.

back_url.description: If set, the hosted checkout page displays a back button which allows customers to cancel the flow and be directed to this URL.

billing_customer_id.description: ID of the [Billing Customer](/docs/api/billing/billing_customers) associated with this Checkout Session, if applicable.

cancelled_at.description: Time when the Checkout Session was cancelled.

client_secret.description: The client secret used to initialize the Checkout Session in `EMBEDDED` or `ELEMENTS` `ui_mode`. Only present when `ui_mode` is `EMBEDDED` or `ELEMENTS`.

completed_at.description: Time when the Checkout Session was completed.

currency.description: The checkout currency in 3-letter ISO-4217 format.

customer_data.description: The prefilled information of the customer.

customer_id.description: ID of the [Customer](/docs/api/payments/customers) from the Payments API associated with this Checkout Session, if applicable.

payment_intent_data.description: The Payment Intent parameters configured for this Checkout Session.

payment_intent_id.description: ID of the Payment Intent associated with this Checkout Session.

invoice_creation.description: Invoice creation settings for this Checkout Session.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice for the Checkout Session when `mode` is `PAYMENT`. Only applicable when `status` is `COMPLETED`.

legal_entity_id.description: ID of the legal entity to be used as billing entity, which can be retrieved from the `legal_entity_id` field in the [Retrieve account details API](/docs/api/scale/accounts/retrieve) response.

line_items.description: A list of items the customer is purchasing.

metadata.description: A set of string key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

payment_consent_id.description: ID of the Payment Consent created when the Checkout Session is completed.

payment_options.description: Payment settings of this Checkout Session.

payment_source_id.description: ID of the Payment Source created when the Checkout Session is completed.

return_url.description: The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment on the payment method's app or site, with payment status not confirmed.

subscription_data.description: The settings of subscription to be passed to the subscription creation upon completion of the Checkout Session in `SUBSCRIPTION` mode.

subscription_id.description: ID of the subscription for the Checkout Session when `mode` is `SUBSCRIPTION`. Only applicable when `status` is `COMPLETED`.

ui_mode.description:
The UI mode of the Checkout Session, can be one of:  
`HOSTED`: Customers complete the checkout on an Airwallex-hosted page.  
`EMBEDDED`: Embed the checkout UI directly in your website or app.  
`ELEMENTS`: Build a custom checkout UI using Airwallex Elements.

locale.description: The locale for the Checkout Session.

hosted_completion_page.description: Configuration of the customer experience after the Checkout Session completes. Only applicable when `ui_mode` is `HOSTED`.

ui_options.description: Customization options for the Checkout Page.

url.description: The URL to the Checkout Session. Only present when `status` is `ACTIVE`.

BillingAddressCollection.description:
Controls whether the billing address will be collected during checkout.
- `AUTO`: Billing address is collected only when necessary, including when automatic tax is enabled or a tax ID is collected.
- `REQUIRED`: Billing address is always collected.
Defaults to `AUTO`.

discounts.description: List of discounts applied to the line item. Discounts of line items are applied before subscription or invoice discounts. Currently, only one element is supported.

quantity.description: The quantity of the line item being purchased.

tax_percent.description: The effective tax percent of this line item.

country_code.description: The two-letter country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

state.description: State or province of the address.

phone_number.description:
Controls whether the phone number will be collected during checkout.
- `AUTO`: Phone number is collected only when necessary.
- `REQUIRED`: Phone number is always collected.

name.description:
Controls whether the name will be collected during checkout.
- `AUTO`: Name is collected only when necessary, including when an invoice is created or when required by the selected payment method.
- `REQUIRED`: Name is always collected.

email.description:
Controls whether the email address will be collected during checkout.
- `AUTO`: Email address is collected only when necessary, including when an invoice is created or when required by the selected payment method.
- `REQUIRED`: Email address is always collected.

Checkout_CustomerDataCollection.description: Provides configuration for the Checkout Session to collect information from customers.

display.description: Whether to display the Airwallex-hosted completion page after the Checkout Session completes and before the customer is redirected to `success_url`.

Checkout_HostedCompletionPage.description: Configuration of the customer experience after the Checkout Session completes.

days_until_due.description: Number of days from invoice finalization until payment is due.

default_tax_percent.description: The tax rate between 0 and 100(%) to be applied to invoices to be generated. The tax will be exclusive. Defaults to 0.

due_at.description: Due date set by the merchant for this invoice, if any.

memo.description: String used for merchants to share a custom message to their customers. Referenced as memo or invoice note in Webapp.

additionalProperties.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

Checkout_InvoiceDataResponse.description: The settings of invoice to be passed to the invoice creation upon completion of the Checkout Session in `PAYMENT` mode.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 country code of the shopper's country. Strongly recommended — drives which payment methods are surfaced (iDEAL / EPS etc. are country-restricted). Falls back to IP geo when absent.

email.description:
The prefilled email of the customer.
If this field, or a `customer_id` or `billing_customer_id` with an email on file, is provided, the email will be prefilled and will not be editable during checkout.
If no email is provided, the Checkout Session prompts the customer to enter their email.

name.description:
The prefilled name of the customer.
If this field, or a `customer_id` or `billing_customer_id` with a name on file, is provided, the name will be prefilled and will not be editable during checkout.
If no name is provided, the Checkout Session prompts the customer to enter their name.

type.description: Type of the customer, one of `BUSINESS` or `INDIVIDUAL`. If not provided and no type is available from an existing customer, an "I am purchasing as a business" checkbox is displayed for the customer to self-select.

Checkout_PrefilledCustomerData.description: Customer data prefilled by the merchant when creating the Checkout Session. Surfaced to the Checkout Page to pre-populate form fields and to drive country-aware payment method surfacing.

first_name.description: First name of the recipient. Maximum of 128 characters.

last_name.description: Last name of the recipient. Maximum of 128 characters.

phone_number.description: Phone number of the recipient. Maximum of 50 characters.

shipping_delayed_at.description: Use if customer chose to deliver the item at a later time. The timestamp must include an explicit timezone, for example `Z` or `-04:00`.

shipping_method.description: Shipping method for the product. Maximum of 128 characters.

Checkout_Shipping.description: Shipping details for the Checkout Session.

CouponDiscountDataRequest.description: Coupon to redeem into a discount for this resource. Only required when `type` = `COUPON`.

type.description: Specifies how to obtain the discount. One of: `COUPON`.

enabled.description: Whether an invoice is created for this Checkout Session.

invoice_data.description: The invoice settings used for this Checkout Session.

payment_methods.description: Specify the layout for the payment elements. Accepted values are `tab` and `accordion`. By default, `accordion` layout is used on desktop and `tab` layout is used on mobile. Only applicable when no invoice is created.

Layout.description: The layout of the Checkout Page.

descriptor.description: Descriptor that will display to the customer on their bank statement. Maximum length is 32. Only applicable when `mode` is `PAYMENT`.

merchant_order_id.description: The order unique identifier created in merchant's order system that corresponds to this Payment Intent. Maximum length is 64.

PaymentIntentData.description: Payment Intent parameters for a Checkout Session.

payment_method_types.description:
Specify which payment methods to display on the Checkout Page and set their display order. Only methods supported for the specified currency and the customer's country code will appear on the Checkout Page. If omitted, all available payment methods are displayed in the default order.  
Possible values when `mode` is `SUBSCRIPTION`: `card`, `applepay`, `googlepay`, `alipaycn`, `alipayhk`, `dana`, `gcash`, `kakaopay`, `klarna`, `rabbit_line_pay`, `tng`, `truemoney`.  
Possible values when `mode` is `PAYMENT`: `card`, `applepay`, `googlepay`, `wechatpay`, `alipaycn`, `alipayhk`, `gcash`, `dana`, `kakaopay`, `tng`, `truemoney`, `bkash`, `poli`, `fpx`, `bank_transfer`, `alfamart`, `doku_ewallet`, `enets`, `grabpay`, `indomaret`, `konbini`, `online_banking`, `payeasy`, `payeasy_atm`, `seven_eleven`, `skrill`, `tesco_lotus`, `eps`, `giropay`, `bancontact`, `ideal`, `multibanco`, `p24`, `sofort`, `trustly`, `dragonpay`, `blik`, `mybank`, `paybybankapp`, `safetypay`, `verkkopankki`, `maxima`, `narvesen`, `paypost`, `perlas_terminals`, `paysafecash`, `paysafecard`, `paysera`, `satispay`, `family_mart`, `hi_life`, `permata_atm`, `sam_kiosk`, `axs_kiosk`, `esun`, `shopee_pay`, `boost`, `paypal`, `payu`, `bitpay`, `ovo`, `rabbit_line_pay`, `ach_direct_debit`, `bacs_direct_debit`, `becs_direct_debit`, `sepa_direct_debit`, `eft_direct_debit`, `atome`, `go_pay`, `jenius_pay`, `linkaja`, `duit_now`, `pay_now`, `prompt_pay`, `airwallex_pay`, `fps`, `klarna`, `korean_local_card`, `payco`, `samsung_pay`, `naver_pay`, `toss_pay`, `upi`, `line_pay`, `paypay`, `merpay`, `d_barai`, `au_pay`, `rakuten_pay`, `zip`, `spei`, `afterpay`, `airi`, `lumi`, `payto`, `twint`, `venmo`, `pix`, `laybuy`, `cash_app_pay`, `payme`, `octopus`, `tabby`, `spaylater`, `wero`, `jkopay`, `affirm`, `bizum`, `cartes_bancaires`, `swish`, `mbway`.  
Possible values when `mode` is `SETUP`: `card`.

auto_capture.description: Whether the amount should be captured automatically upon successful payment authorization. Set to `false` to place a hold on the payment method and capture the funds later. Defaults to `true`. Only applicable when `mode` is `PAYMENT`.

pay_by_invoice_enabled.description: Enables the option to "Request an invoice" for payment. After the customer confirms to pay with this option, the status of Checkout Session will transit to COMPLETED, and an invoice will be generated. The invoice will inherit the payment_options of this Checkout Session, and other configurations in `invoice_creation.invoice_data`. Only applicable when an invoice is created, and the customer type is `BUSINESS`.

authorization_type.description: The authorization type of the card payment. One of `final_auth`, `pre_auth`. Defaults to `final_auth`. Set it to `pre_auth` if you want to place a hold on your customer's card for more than 7 days. `pre_auth` is only applicable to Visa or Mastercard and requires `auto_capture` to be `false`. Only applicable when `mode` is `PAYMENT`.

allowed_card_networks.description: One or more card networks that you support. Accepted values are `visa`, `mastercard`, `maestro`, `unionpay`, `amex`, `jcb`, `diners`, and `discover`. Only applicable when `mode` is `PAYMENT`.

payment_method_save.description: Settings that control whether and how the payment method can be reused for future payments.

PaymentOptions.description: Payment settings of this Checkout Session.

mode.description:
Whether and how to store the payment method used in this Checkout Session for future payments. Accepted values:
- `ENABLED`: Always store the payment method when possible; no checkbox is shown.
- `DISABLED`: Never store the payment method; always treat the transaction as guest checkout.
- `COLLECT_CONSENT`: Show a checkbox and only store the payment method if the customer explicitly opts in. Only applicable to cards.

next_triggered_by.description:
Indicates who will use the saved Payment Source or Payment Consent to trigger future payments. One of `MERCHANT` or `CUSTOMER`.
If `MERCHANT`, a Payment Source or Payment Consent is created for future use. If `CUSTOMER`, the payment method is saved only with the payment provider.

PaymentSourceOptions.description: Settings that control how the payment method can be reused for future payments (Card-on-File / recurring agreements).

RequiredInfoCollection.description: Controls whether the customer information is collected during checkout.

days_until_due.description: Number of days from invoice finalization until payment is due. Defaults to `0`.

default_invoice_template.description: Invoices for the Subscription will be created using the specified settings.

default_tax_percent.description: The tax rate between 0 and 100(%) to be applied to invoices to be generated. The tax will be exclusive. Defaults to 0.

duration.description: The total duration of the subscription.

additionalProperties.description: A set of string key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

metadata.description: A set of string key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

recurring.description: The billing cycle for recurring charges.

starts_at.description: Time when the subscription started or scheduled to start. Defaults to start immediately after creation.

trial_ends_at.description: The end time of the trial if applicable.

SubscriptionDataResponse.description: The settings of subscription returned on the Checkout Session response. The billing cycle (`recurring`) is computed from line items.

invoice_memo.description: Memo to be used for the invoices that are generated by this Subscription.

SubscriptionDefaultInvoiceTemplateRespon.description: Invoices for the Subscription will be created using the specified settings.

period_unit.description: Specifies billing duration. One of `DAY`, `WEEK`, `MONTH` or `YEAR`.

SubscriptionDurationResponse.description: The total duration of the subscription.

period.description: The number of period units between subscription billing cycles. For example, the billing cycle is bi-monthly if `period=2` and `period_unit=MONTH`.

period_unit.description: Specifies billing frequency. One of `DAY`, `WEEK`, `MONTH` or `YEAR`.

SubscriptionRecurringResponse.description: The billing cycle for recurring charges.

TaxIdCollection.description:
Controls whether the tax ID will be collected for a business customer during checkout.
- `DISABLED`: Tax ID will not be collected.
- `OPTIONAL_IF_SUPPORTED`: Tax ID is optionally collected in supported countries by displaying the "I am purchasing as a business" checkbox.
- `REQUIRED_IF_SUPPORTED`: Tax ID is always collected when the country is supported.
Defaults to `OPTIONAL_IF_SUPPORTED`.

theme_id.description: ID of the theme to apply to this Checkout Session, overriding the theme applied to its legal entity. You can find this ID in the Airwallex web app > Settings > Themes.

submit_type.description: Describes the type of transaction being performed in order to customize the submit button text. Accepted values are `pay`, `book`, `subscribe`, and `save`.

UiOptions.description: Customization options for the Checkout Page.
